messages.author: c94520e338a9c3ea
messages.subject: Comments - feature request
parts:
Hi all,

I am using Stata for the past 3 years and i am trying to make my jump
to R. In Stata i use only the commands under "File" tab (open, save,
import, export). Although there are plenty of other functions
available. I do not consider myself an expert in Stata or the command
line

What i like best in Stata's GUI is that it helps you with the command
line. What i mean is that with a "click" in the variables or command
review window, the variables or previous commands are inserted into
the command line. This saves time and is convenient. I have tried
nearly every R GUI looking for approximately these features. As far as
i know JGR & PMG partially do that (drag n drop). That kind of GUI
(like Stata) is for both, the experts and the newcomers.

I have tried Deducer and i liked it and though it is in its early
development it looks promising. Personally, i would like a GUI that
will assist the command line and not replace it ,like SPSS does.

Thank you
Eugene
